Name: Cool Capybaras
Author: nugmods
Description:
A retexture for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46817]Mizu's Capybaras[/url] that I shuffled out early to support a fellow community member in an upcoming endeavor! ;) Remember, stay cool, and definitely listen to the [url=www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Pj-YEQbojk]Capybara Song.[/url]

This is the only mod I've ever opted into DP, and 100% of any DP earned will be going to Doctors Without Borders.

[b]Installation[/b]
Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46817]Mizu's Capybaras[/url], then download my mod, and put both in your Mods folder. It's that simple!

[b]Credits[/b]
Mizu - for her many animal mods that inspired these retextures
Siamece, Cajcbell, and Kwillow - for artistic inspiration 
Scarlett - for helping my test that the sprites are working :)
